shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure carved in the round
human head with schematic large facial features
patterned/incised head covering or cap with parallel and cross-hatched lines
curved raised bands or ridges on the body
broad horizontal band or girdle across the body
justification: Both depict a massive blocky anthropomorphic figure whose surface carries low-relief and incised secondary ornament, most specifically a patterned head covering rendered as ruled/cross-hatched lines over the crown, plus curved ridges and a ring-and-band motif on the body of B that has some counterpart in the ridged forms of A. The biggest difference in depicted content is that A foregrounds a fully modelled face with deep-set eyes, nose and mouth beneath a net-like cap, while B shows an essentially featureless torso with isolated disc, arc and girdle motifs, so the specific combinations and placements of the ornaments do not correspond.
